query:
INSERT INTO schedules (id, tenant_id, day, slot, duration, room, subject_id)
                   VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
                   ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                     day = EXCLUDED.day,
                     slot = EXCLUDED.slot,
                     duration = EXCLUDED.duration,
                     room = EXCLUDED.room,
                     subject_id = EXCLUDED.subject_id,
                     updated_at = now()
